scope: Independent local source/static-original review of exact second runner, immutable guardian and fifth built MSI; no Windows/native/Cargo/network operation by reviewer. Root may separately be starting actual third fixture; no live runtime report read or verdict fabricated.

confirmedFinding.problem: Committed uninstall did not require raw msiExitCode0; with End0/guardian exit0/product absent/payload absent it could satisfy overall four-operation flag despite a failing uninstall client exit.
confirmedFinding.fix: Exactly one added rejection for uninstall-commit nonzero MSI exit. Existing install/repair0 guards unchanged. Rollback original code remains unmodified and is not forced0.

safetyConclusions.finding: Native RegCreateKeyExW returns handle+disposition in one operation under existing Software; actual NEW required before same returned SafeRegistryHandle markers. Existing/partial marker/parent-close failure does not authorize MSI or deletion. Single random leaf avoids intermediate parent remnants.

Ready/ACK handshake lets supervisor retain exact guardian Process handle, compare recorded actual PID creation FILETIME/SID and extracted image SHA before ACK. Later actual original msiexec exit and guardian WaitForExit are mandatory; registry AboutToReturnCode and owner-change event are not physical completion.

Unknown after started MSI, missing guardian, missing/nonzero End, timed-out query or unresolved original return sets sticky unknown and forbids next MSI/final registry deletion. No Kill, StopProcess or msiserver/service mutation. Owned process object may remain unresolved rather than being guessed complete.

Known negative cleanup requires original NEW+both markers+same owner handle, all recorded original actual exits, matching last operation control, bounded allowlisted subtree and exact own product absent. It deletes only fixed nonce leaf and reopens after original handle disposal to observe absence. This is not a same-SID hostile CAS claim.

MSI is single per-user registry-only synthetic product; Intel/500, one Binary guardian/chainer row, exact HKCU DWORD component, no installed File/CustomAction/service/shortcut/Upgrade actions. Raw compiled guardian byte-equals extracted Binary stream. No Run, app startup, ProgramData, trust or user desktop payload.

staticOnly.knownPriorCompilerFailures: First UNICODE and second missing import-thunk failures remain untouched; static success is not Join/End or maintenance-mode runtime proof.

remainingObservationLimitations: Read-ProductState query timeout marks unknown and stops mutation, but its process PID/start identity is only added to its row after actual return. In such a failure original diagnostic process may lack a complete persisted identity receipt; do not guess one, kill by name or delete its image/root while unresolved.
Runner records SafeRegistryHandle Dispose, not a separately checked native RegCloseKey receipt. Physical process exit and final reopen absence are distinct from a disposal request.

MsiJoin/MsiEnd no-extra-package and /f or /x invocation behavior are intentionally unproven until real fixture execution. A native error is a legitimate falsification/inconclusive outcome, not permission to widen guards or deadlines.

The PowerShell runner preserves TEMP raw report/MSI logs and does not delete its TEMP fixture directory. Final file-root cleanup is an external exact-owned operation only after physical completion and original-byte capture.

alwaysSafeReadOnly: Preserve controller exit/stderr and complete windows-observations/MSI logs; copy/hash pinned inputs and original report without rewriting statuses.

Read exact random ProductCode state, marker/evidence tree and current recorded process HANDLE/PID+creation/image identity only with a bounded owned observer; a query itself must be physically returned before subsequent cleanup.

Observe existing recorded original process handles and their exit codes; compare exact nonce/SID/control/evidence scalars. Do not interpret absence of a log line, AboutToReturnCode or an engine event as physical completion.
knownOnlyCleanup: Use original script cleanup only when all original MSI/guardian returns and End success are known, unknown=false, NEW+markers/closed subtree still exact. Then exact own ProductCode /x may be attempted, with its new original guardian/MSI physically observed before deleting only own nonce registry leaf.
After exact own product absent, original native owners returned, registry leaf absent and all raw bytes captured, remove only the externally claimed exact TEMP fixture directory and its known files.
mustRetain: Any running/unidentified original MSI/guardian/query, missing End result or ownership/marker/structure uncertainty retains the relevant scope; no next MSI, retry or broad compensation.
Existing-key disposition never authorizes deleting that root. Partial markers are conservatively retained by current runner; preserve actual NEW/progress receipt rather than invent complete markers.
never: Kill/restart shared msiserver or arbitrary msiexec by name
Modify real FutureClassroom Run value or other products
Treat first failure or second static/third model success as native lifecycle acceptance
